function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details. MUST be called and MUST return verified:true before the agent discloses loan/EMI/overdue information.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or birth year provided by the user.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay (PTP) date and amount committed by the customer.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date agreed upon for payment, e.g. 2026-08-14

amount.description: The amount (INR) the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call/case to a human collections agent or grievance officer for hardship, dispute, or any case the AI cannot resolve.

notes.description: Free-text context to hand off to the human agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome/disposition status in the database. Must be called exactly once before the call ends.
